SELECT p.order_id, p.order_name, p.amount, p.status, p.payment_kind, p.billing_cycle, p.user_id, u.email AS user_email, t.name AS team_name, p.approved_at, p.created_dt AS created_at, p.refunded_amount, p.canceled_at AS refunded_at, p.refund_reason, CASE WHEN p.payment_key IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_payment_key FROM payments p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = p.team_id
(UPPER(p.order_id) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\' OR UPPER(u.email) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\' OR UPPER(p.order_name) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\' OR UPPER(t.name) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\')
AND p.status = #{status}
ORDER BY p.payment_id DESC FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY

SELECT user_id AS id, email, nickname, real_name, CASE WHEN password_hash IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_password, created_dt AS created_at, last_login_at FROM users WHERE email_verified_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
AND (UPPER(email) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\' OR UPPER(nickname) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\' OR UPPER(real_name) LIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\')
ORDER BY user_id DESC FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
